title: Southwestern Turkey, Corn, and White Bean Chili
intro: A hearty serving of lean protein and dietary fiber helps keep your energy steady through the afternoon. Using low-sodium canned staples means this earthy, comforting bowl is ready without the traditional all-day simmer.

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned cannellini beans
ingredients.canonical_name: Beans, white, mature seeds, canned, no salt added

ingredients.name: Low-sodium diced green chiles
ingredients.canonical_name: Peppers, hot chili, green, canned, drained solids

ingredients.name: Low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, chicken broth, low sodium, canned

instructions: Heat oil in a medium pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add turkey, cumin, and garlic powder to the pot. Cook, breaking meat apart with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 4 to 5 minutes.
Stir in drained beans, corn, drained green chiles, broth, and water. Bring mixture to a rolling boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a gentle simmer. Cook uncovered to blend flavors, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Remove pot from heat. Stir in lime juice and chopped cilantro just before serving.
variation: Swap the ground turkey for an equal amount of ground chicken.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat on the stovetop or microwave.
